Company X does A
Company X is doing well

What you don’t see is that A was a result of constant refinement and adaptation. That is what you must copy. Not A.

One major challenge is that “product” has become synonymous with product management (e.g. the product team). And design a subset of product management.

An alternative (on the left), is that eng, PdM, and design all contribute to “the product”.
Why are we going so slow?

I love when teams put together homegrown health checks. I don't care if it is scientific or "rigorous" if it helps them have a conversation about what they value. This one is great. #prodmgmt #ux #design #agile

great quote from a friend whose agency consistently gets "big" projects done "on time and on budget"...

"the key to getting something done in 6 months, is to get a version of it done in 6 days, and expose it to the real world"
